purpose: Typed templates for source-backed psychological records, source-version-specific domain rosters, related consciousness concepts, and explicitly provisional crosswalks. Template completeness does not confer canonical approval.
fieldContract: fields are required: every reader of this catalog counts an empty one as incomplete or an error. optionalFields (added 1.4.0) are declared for a template but may be absent, and an absent one never makes a record incomplete. A reader that only knows fields ignores optionalFields, so records and readers from 1.3.0 still load unchanged.
